digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure - subprocess and network timeout oracles
propositions: Slow-progress stall test uses production 10s low-speed window and 15s real loopback server, consuming 15+ seconds per run despite contract being sustained bytes above floor for one window, not elapsed time.

ACLI read-retry test launches real child processes with 1s per-attempt deadline plus production 2s/4s backoff sleeps across three attempts, consuming ~9s despite contract being exact retry schedule and process cleanup, not elapsed seconds.
Injected test-only timeouts (1s low-speed window, 0.1s call/grace/drain) with real socket/process execution and polling-based cleanup can verify the same contracts in low single-digit seconds.
Production defaults for timeout, stall window, grace, drain, attempt count, and backoff schedule must remain byte-unchanged and untested by wall-clock assertions.
